integrity: No independent audit or external validation is claimed; proof and reproducible source are provided.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical Euclidean Petersen symmetric edge polytope, not other Kneser graphs or affine embeddings.
The 11-shell and 18-orbit classification is finite exact arithmetic with an exhaustive standalone checker.
A prior study already determined the largest radius shell, the 30 contacts, and the total 1410 facets; they are background and not originality claims.
Specialist unpublished or differently named equivalent facet-orbit tables cannot be excluded.
title: Complete facet-distance and face-size stratification of the Petersen symmetric edge polytope
